from numbers import Complex, Real, Rational, Integral, Number

def _t():
    assert issubclass(int, Integral), ('assertIsSubclass', int, Integral)
    assert issubclass(int, Rational), ('assertIsSubclass', int, Rational)
    assert issubclass(int, Real), ('assertIsSubclass', int, Real)
    assert issubclass(int, Complex), ('assertIsSubclass', int, Complex)
    assert issubclass(int, Number), ('assertIsSubclass', int, Number)
    assert 7 == int(7).real, ('assertEqual', 7, int(7).real)
    assert 0 == int(7).imag, ('assertEqual', 0, int(7).imag)
    assert 7 == int(7).conjugate(), ('assertEqual', 7, int(7).conjugate())
    assert -7 == int(-7).conjugate(), ('assertEqual', -7, int(-7).conjugate())
    assert 7 == int(7).numerator, ('assertEqual', 7, int(7).numerator)
    assert 1 == int(7).denominator, ('assertEqual', 1, int(7).denominator)
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')

from numbers import Complex, Real, Rational, Integral, Number

def _t():
    assert not issubclass(float, Integral), ('assertNotIsSubclass', float, Integral)
    assert not issubclass(float, Rational), ('assertNotIsSubclass', float, Rational)
    assert issubclass(float, Real), ('assertIsSubclass', float, Real)
    assert issubclass(float, Complex), ('assertIsSubclass', float, Complex)
    assert issubclass(float, Number), ('assertIsSubclass', float, Number)
    assert 7.3 == float(7.3).real, ('assertEqual', 7.3, float(7.3).real)
    assert 0 == float(7.3).imag, ('assertEqual', 0, float(7.3).imag)
    assert 7.3 == float(7.3).conjugate(), ('assertEqual', 7.3, float(7.3).conjugate())
    assert -7.3 == float(-7.3).conjugate(), ('assertEqual', -7.3, float(-7.3).conjugate())
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')
